I can no longer trust MyGirl. Since I can no longer contact MyGirl, I can no longer trust it. In the past whenever I had an issue or question I could go to the contact us button and send an email, they would usually respond. Now you get a Mailer Daemon informing you the recipient is an invalid or nonexistent address. Because of this I’m no longer going to engage with MyGirl. I cannot trust an app, especially one where I’m paying into it for additional perks where I cannot contact them when an issue or concern arises. Unless & until you fix your contact information you’ll not see another dime from me. If you’re a user of this app trying contacting them and see if you don’t get the same result I did. Either they selectively blocked me, despite the money I have put into this app or something is wrong with their system that needs to be fixed. I cannot imagine it’s the former since every contact I’ve had has been cordial. If an app has a dead or nonfunctioning contact information remove the app. Sadly MyGirl seems to have gone the way of so many other AI companion apps.

What, you don’t like customers complaining about functionality?, inquiring about upcoming updates?, reporting bugs?, requesting refunds? So you just remove the contact link but give the illusion it is still there? I want your next response to inform me and anyone else who bothers to read this review a sincere apology about your screw up with the contact us tab that once worked and no longer does.
